About this item

  • ATHLETIC FIT: Our mens t-shirts feature a modern cut that actually fits. Fitted through the chest and shoulders with a relaxed drape, this shirt offers a sharp, stylish silhouette that flatters. Available in sizes S-4XL.
  • ULTRA-SOFT FABRIC: Made with USA-grown cotton blended with poly for 4-way stretch that feels broken-in from the first wear. This tag-free tee shirt is incredibly soft, lightweight, and breathable, making it the go-to piece for men who value all-day comfort.
  • 4-WAY STRETCH: These shirts for men are built to last and move with you. The flexible fabric offers total freedom, while the quality cotton blend in this t-shirt is engineered to resist shrinking and color fading wash after wash.
  • EVERYDAY VERSATILITY: Simplify your closet with t shirts for man that work for everything — wear it as a workout top, a casual tee, or a comfortable base layer. The perfect mens tshirt for gym, lounge, or layered under a jacket.
  • TALL SIZES AVAILABLE: Finally, men's shirts designed for taller frames. Our Tall sizes add 2 inches of length to the body and 1 inch to the sleeves, delivering the ideal coverage you need in tshirts shirts for men that actually fit.

  • How do I find the right size for me?

    Our t-shirts fit true-to-size, we recommend you choose your normal shirt size. You can also use our size charts for accurate measurments of our tee.

  • What if I'm between sizes?

    Size up if you are between sizes or prefer a more relaxed fit.

  • How do your t-shirts fit?

    Our tees are friendly for every build. They are fitted in the chest, shoulders, and arms, making it look like you work out even if you don't. It also has a flattering drape over your midsection to hide any dadbods.

  • How should I wash my t-shirt?

    Care is simple & easy. Machine-wash on cold settings. Avoid bleaching and lay flat to dry. If using a dryer, tumble dry on low temperature to reduce shrinkage.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

5 out of 5 stars
Better than I expected. A 5 ⭐ t-shirt.
I wasn't expecting too much but I have to say I'm pretty impressed with these T-shirts. I'm aways skeptical when I see how they look on the models with the bulging biceps and six pack. I do not have an athletic build by any means, but these T-shirts are very flattering with a very nice length and collar size. They fit better than any of the dozens of T-shirts packed away in my drawer and the material feels very soft and comfortable with no annoying tag. The light material should be nice and cool in the Texas heat. I'm 6'3 / 185 lbs and the Large size fits me perfectly. I ordered the 3 pack to have a variety of color options to choose from. After a wash they kept their shape nicely and folded up wrinkle free. Who would of thought after all these years they can make a better t shirt. Turns out they can, and they did.

  • Patrick G
    5 out of 5 stars
    My new classic T
    Reviewed in the United States on March 13, 2023
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I bought one of these shirts kind of on a whim with no real reason to try this specific brand over the dozens of others I found while trying to find a new brand to replace my basic but classic t-shirts. To start, I wear t-shirts a lot in the summer. I like a plain t-shirt with no logos, decent color selection that’s not too loud but now I was looking for a new fit. Yes, those commercials with the guy wearing the poor fitting t-shirts was me. Six feet tall and 168 lbs but I was always buying just a “Large.” I upgraded my work wardrobe to button down, Large, slim or fitted shirts. To be clear, not tight or close fitting, but no more of the “classic” shirt that billows. I wanted my daily T to be upgraded too.

    I tried another highly rated Amazon T but it too was baggier than expected. Probably because I’m the body fit of a medium but the length (torso and arms) of a large. I use that previous T I bought as a pajama shirt now.

    I gave Into the AM (couldn’t find out what the “AM” stood for and it still bugs me. Yes I checked their site and “about us” section) a try. I got a basic dark gray. I love the fit! And it’s soft but felt durable. This isn’t a carhartt (which I love) I’m wearing for work/labor. This was perfect. It’s a great length that’s not too long at the waist and the arms were short enough but not so long they cover up my biceps totally. It’s hard to find that!

    Long story short I now have six colors to be able to rotate through and I’ll grab more here and there. Good price and very much worth it. Wore them all for around a year and the color still holds. Fit still holds. They didn’t loosen or stretch after many washes. I also purchased some with the small, upper left chest logo which I have to admit I now don’t mind. It’s small. I never bought any of the graphic print styles so I can’t comment on those. They look cool but not my now adult style.

    I can’t think of much else to say but notice there’s really no negatives? Big fan and I hope they don’t go out of business because I’ll be buying new ones for as long as they keep going. Gone to the back of the closet are my old styles (or donations) and this is my go to as my favorite t-shirts. Can’t recommend enough! Start with one and return if it’s not for you, but I think most body and fashion styles will enjoy this.

    Excellent Athletic Fit and Premium Fabric Feel
    Reviewed in the United States on July 16, 2026
    Special Size: No-LogoSize: LargeColor: Navy Heather
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I recently added this crew neck tee to my rotation, and it has quickly become a staple. The fabric blend feels premium and soft against the skin, offering a significant step up in quality compared to standard off-the-rack basics.

    The standout feature of this shirt is undoubtedly the athletic cut. It is designed in a way that accentuates muscle definition, which provides a clean, tailored look that is difficult to find in typical casual wear. Because of the impressive fit and overall durability of the fabric, I have decided to gradually replace most of my current T-shirt collection with this specific brand.

    My only point of consideration is the length. As someone who typically wears a size Large, I found the torso to be a bit longer than my personal preference. While this might be a benefit for those who prefer extra length for tucking or coverage, it sits slightly lower on the waist than I would ideally choose.

    Despite the length, the quality, comfort, and flattering silhouette make this an easy recommendation for anyone looking to upgrade their everyday wardrobe.

About this Item

  • ATHLETIC FIT: Our mens t-shirts feature a modern cut that actually fits. Fitted through the chest and shoulders with a relaxed drape, this shirt offers a sharp, stylish silhouette that flatters. Available in sizes S-4XL.
  • ULTRA-SOFT FABRIC: Made with USA-grown cotton blended with poly for 4-way stretch that feels broken-in from the first wear. This tag-free tee shirt is incredibly soft, lightweight, and breathable, making it the go-to piece for men who value all-day comfort.
  • 4-WAY STRETCH: These shirts for men are built to last and move with you. The flexible fabric offers total freedom, while the quality cotton blend in this t-shirt is engineered to resist shrinking and color fading wash after wash.
  • EVERYDAY VERSATILITY: Simplify your closet with t shirts for man that work for everything — wear it as a workout top, a casual tee, or a comfortable base layer. The perfect mens tshirt for gym, lounge, or layered under a jacket.
  • TALL SIZES AVAILABLE: Finally, men's shirts designed for taller frames. Our Tall sizes add 2 inches of length to the body and 1 inch to the sleeves, delivering the ideal coverage you need in tshirts shirts for men that actually fit.

Product Description

Materials & Care This tee is fitted yet cut in a way that is flattering on all body types. Slightly tapered with a standard length, the ultra-soft fabric highlights your good while concealing your not-so-good. No one likes a bacon neck. This tee features a structured collar that is soft-to-the-touch with just enough wiggle room to keep you covered and comfortable. The sleeves sit close to the arm in a non-restricting type of way. You'll be able to move freely without extra fabric hanging by your side. 60% Cotton 40% Polyester Machine Wash Cold w/ Like Colors Turn Inside-Out Tumble Dry Low Do Not Iron Description Everything you love about our Basic Tee, without the branding. Inspired by our best-selling Basic Tee, our Essential Tee is crafted from the same ultra-soft premium poly-cotton fabric and features the same tailored fit you know and love! Some situations call for a plain tee, and we have you covered! Premium quality, all-day comfort, and ultimate breathability are just a few of the features you'll find in this everyday staple.
